scope: Twenty source photographs, including two multiple-heart scenes and three clearly non-semicircular cap outlines. No filtering on crop, mask or fit outcomes. Additional source-group evaluation, not a guarantee against unknown pretraining overlap.

selection.rule: All unassigned photograph sources whose split group and near-duplicate group do not intersect any existing body annotation; one largest-resolution asset per split group, SHA tie break. Sort by SHA. Scope review happens before model inference.

frontend.selectionRule: One fixed final checkpoint with the most real training instances; lexical fold ID breaks ties. Same checkpoint for every new photograph, chosen before inference. No motif-family oracle or outcome-based choice.
frontend.differenceFromDevelopmentReplay: The earlier 22-photo study used family-held-out checkpoints. This new evaluation uses one fixed checkpoint, so the result is not a strict same-model extension of its 15/22 score.
frontend.input: Full EXIF-normalized original RGB; identical continuous 256px letterbox sampler used by training. No manual ROI, corners, counts or masks.
frontend.palette: Frozen RGB-illumination calibration using predicted foreground. Record calibration failures and retain every input in the denominator.

cropPolicy: Previously validated single-point SAM crop, no-contrast retry only after crop rejection, then two-paper SAM crop only after both reject. Existing support gates unchanged.
fitting: Ten-second automatic preset, binary classified mask, full source observation coverage, no saved paths or count seeds. Independent exported mask and editable geometry replay.
evaluation: Lock selected sources and the fixed checkpoint before inference; source bytes and policies must remain unchanged during the experiment.
Inspect all sources, prompts, segmentations, proposed corners and exported weaves. Report crop and source-classification failures separately from curve-fitting failures.
Count full original photograph inputs, including incomplete localization, printed papers, multi-heart scenes and nonstandard outer silhouettes. Keep pre-inference scope exclusions separately visible.
Mask agreement and geometry checks do not certify underlying paper identity or unseen physical cutting paths. No global accuracy claim from self-derived masks.
No tuning on this batch before the frozen results and visual audit are saved; any subsequent changes require a separate experiment.
No deployment, retraining or browser-inference speed claim. MobileSAM pretraining overlap with public images is unknown.
